metadesc: Learn how to close room inventory and block booking dates using Stop sell switches in your distribution settings, then save and manage availability across vcms.io.

hotspots.text: Turn on Stop sell for the date you want and that room type stops selling on the channel.
Use the All rooms row to stop selling every room type on that date.
Press Save to apply the changes to the channel.
Saved changes are pushed to the channels together.

title: VCMS stop sell change
